name: singlet_genetics_expression_cnv_inference
title: Infer copy-number states from scRNA-seq expression
description: Calls per-cell, per-segment copy-number states (loss, neutral, gain) from gene expression ordered along the genome, relative to normal reference cells, and writes segment scores plus cell-level aneuploidy and clone labels. The default method copykat needs only counts and gene coordinates; numbat adds haplotype-aware calls and loss of heterozygosity when an allele table is supplied. Do not use it to detect copy-neutral events without allele counts, or focal events, which expression resolves weakly.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle, with counts and gene coordinates.

method.description: copykat for expression-only data; numbat when numbat.allele_table is set.

reference_obs_key.description: obs column marking normal reference cells; required for numbat, null runs copykat reference-free.

genome_build.description: Gene coordinate build; must equal uns/genome_build recorded at ingest.

device.description: Execution device; wrapped callers use CPU, and CUDA applies to the planned HMM path.

seed.description: Seed for copykat MCMC segmentation and numbat initialisation.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

copykat.description: Options used only when method is copykat.

ks_cut.description: Segmentation cut-off for MCMC breakpoints; halved when fewer than 25 breakpoints are found.

win_size.description: Minimal window size in genes for segmentation.

low_dr.description: Minimal population fraction of genes used in smoothing.

up_dr.description: Minimum population fraction used in segmentation.

ngene_chr.description: Minimum genes per chromosome, used in cell filtering.

min_gene_per_cell.description: Minimum detected genes for a cell to be analysed.

numbat.description: Options used only when method is numbat.

allele_table.description: Per-cell allele counts at heterozygous SNPs; enables haplotype-aware calls and loss of heterozygosity.

t.description: Transition probability of the segment HMM.

gamma.description: Beta-Binomial overdispersion of the allele model.

init_k.description: Number of clusters in the initial clustering.

tau.description: Factor setting the maximum clone cost from cell number, between 0 and 1.

scevan.description: Options used only when method is scevan.

beta_vega.description: Segmentation granularity; higher values give coarser segments.

perc_genes.description: Minimum percentage of genes expressed per cell.

casper.description: Options used only when method is casper.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/cnv_state. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, cells_in, reference_cells, segments, cells_aneuploid, clones. Never matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
